live_order_policy: User authorizes autonomous execution after thesis validation without per-trade user approval. Place trades only while the US regular market session is open. Complete the broker review immediately before placement, obey any broker-enforced confirmation requirement that cannot be bypassed, persist every decision, and learn from outcomes.

tactical_swing_sleeve.purpose: Short-horizon, catalyst-driven swing trades that pass every validation and execution gate.

results_driven_sizing.buy_notional: min(requested percent of live total_value, edge-scaled max_stake, spendable cash)
results_driven_sizing.max_stake: private.edge_max_stake via steward_sizing_guidance / public.v_thesis_max_stake: starter while unproven (n_eff<10 or LCB<=0) = 0.03 x book / steward bet vol (sd of return on stake, floor 0.25; 1.0 under 5 trades); proven: max(starter, min(book x 0.5 x LCB/sd^2, starter x 2^(1+(n_eff-10)/5))); x steward drawdown scale (1 within 10% of closing high, to 0.5 at 40% below)
results_driven_sizing.entry_requires: invalidation_price passed to steward_sizing_guidance (else missing_invalidation) and written on the new open lot (DB-enforced); book observation <= 6h (else stale_book); open risk <= 10% of book, equities to invalidation (entry fitted via p_entry_price) and ODDSBORNE binaries / BANDIT memes at full notional (risk_basis), else exposure_cap
results_driven_sizing.size_multiplier: retired: the outcome multiplier no longer scales size (docs/rules/confidence-multiplier.md); steward_sizing_guidance no longer returns it
mechanical_limits: spendable cash: min(cash, buying_power), no margin
positive finite dollar amount or share quantity within available shares
US regular session open (orders are regular-hours market orders)
results_driven_sizing.autonomous_buy_gate: thesis hardening, bullish, results score (theses.results_confidence, P(expected return per trade > 0) on >= 3 effective trades) >= 80; unscored -> quantanamo_unscored (David approves); stated confidence never opens the gate
results_driven_sizing.decided: 2026-09-26 David: size follows results with no hard cap per position
results_driven_sizing.entry_blocks: unknown, rejected or killed thesis, missing invalidation, stale book, exposure_cap (all stewards); QUANTANAMO equity entries also need a hardening thesis with results score >= 80
results_driven_sizing.no_fixed_rails: 2026-09-26 David: 'Kill the old rules!' No trade count, spread block, execution window buffer, fixed add %, add count or spacing, reduce band, averaging-down ban, global stop-loss or portfolio drawdown limit.
results_driven_sizing.learned_rules: Beliefs and lessons in force (belief_updates meta.kind = playbook_rule, research_lessons) are learned rules scored by outcomes and stay in force.

execution_gates.guidance_not_blocks: Wide spreads and the first/last 15 minutes of the regular session are guidance for judgment, not blocks.

position_management.exit_source: the lot's own invalidation first (position_episodes.invalidation_price: exit when the price is at or below it; invalidation_note), then the linked thesis's (theses.falsifier); with none written, the steward's judgment and learned beliefs. No global stop-loss.
position_management.add_sizing: requested percent of live total_value, limited by edge-scaled max_stake and spendable cash (no fixed add %, count, spacing or averaging-down rule)
position_management.reduce_sizing: model-requested partial percent (0 < % < 100); no fixed band
